Mod.Name: Floating HP Bar
Mod.Author: JustPeace
Mod.Description:
Displays a polished floating HP bar with the enemy's name and a numeric HP readout above every enemy during battle.
- Enemy name plate above the bar (uses the game's translated battle text) - Smooth fill animation, delayed damage trail and a short hit flash - Colour shifts from green to gold to red as the enemy loses HP - Optional "current / max" display - HP is read through btl_para.GetLogicalHP: vanilla mode shows the enemy's real data HP, while Alternate Fantasy mode automatically removes the scripted +10 000 padding only on flagged bosses. This fixes bosses such as Necron being shown 10 000 HP too low in 1.0.
Configuration is in FloatingHPBar/FloatingHPBar.ini.
Mod.PatchNotes: Version 1.1: enemy names above the bar; fixed boss HP display (no more unconditional -10 000); added HpMode, ShowName and NameFontSize options. Version 1.0: first release.
